eligibility.explanation: The paper reports in vivo MC3 LNP delivery of Cas9 mRNA/NSGHAsgRNA in NSG HemA mice, with deep-sequencing gene-editing outcomes in isolated hepatocytes and LSECs.

composition.value: MC3, cholesterol, DOPE, and DMG-PEG2000 at ratios of 50:10:39:1, respectively
MC3 LNP encapsulating Cas9 mRNA and NSGHAsgRNA

qualitative_outcome.value: Luciferase expression was obtained from both hepatocytes and LSECs.

unresolved_items: The packet does not report the detailed lipid-component ratios or N/P ratio specifically for the Cas9/NSGHAsgRNA LNP; the detailed 50:10:39:1 composition is directly reported for Luc LNP.
The timepoint of isolated hepatocyte and LSEC gene-editing measurement after Cas9/NSGHAsgRNA LNP administration is not provided in the supplied evidence.
The route and timepoint for the 0.2 mg/kg Luc LNP isolated-cell assay are not provided in the supplied evidence.
